trap-triples.notes: STANDING-TRAP FINDING, report only, do not fix inline: clause 4 asserts 'The mirror operation preserves the knot type and its hyperbolic volume.' Mirroring preserves hyperbolic volume, but it does NOT preserve knot type in general - only for amphichiral knots. The block's own opening sentence contradicts it: T_{2,3} and its mirror T_{2,3}^sigma are distinct knots (the trefoil is chiral), which is the whole mechanism of clauses 1-3. Proposed fix: 'The mirror operation preserves the hyperbolic volume.' The mass-invariance conclusion survives, since it depends on volume alone. Secondary: the opening calls T_{2,3} 'the left trefoil'; T_{2,3} is conventionally the right-handed trefoil, so either the chirality convention should be stated or the word dropped. Sign algebra of clause 2 checked and correct: E(H^sigma) = -E(H)|_{q <-> 1/q} maps q -> -q^{-1} and -q^{-1} -> q, matching the section 7a eigenvalue pair.
